args.plainText:
POLICY UPDATE 445

Effective Date: October 15, 2023

Subject: Enhanced Security Protocols for Remote Access

All employees accessing internal HR systems from external networks must utilize the designated VPN gateway. Multi-factor authentication is now mandatory for all administrative accounts. Failure to comply may result in revocation of access privileges.

Additionally, all data transfers exceeding 50MB must be logged via the secure audit portal. This policy supersedes Update 312.

Approved by: Security Compliance Office
Reference: SEC-2023-445
